# Kashvee's Bansuri Hotel (काशीज् बांसुरी हॉटेल)
> Pure vegetarian garden & family restaurant near Shirdi on the Shirdi–Nashik Highway in Chandekasare, Maharashtra.

Kashvee's Bansuri Hotel is a 100% pure vegetarian Indian restaurant with garden seating, a kids play area, free parking, and double-deck glass dining with 360° views. It sits about 6–7 km from the Shirdi Sai Baba temple area and about 7 km from Kopargaon. Guests and pilgrims often describe it as a standout veg stop near Shirdi. Jain families and vegetarians choose it for a clear all-veg kitchen. A signature highlight is the giant masala khakhra, alongside paneer butter masala and home-style thalis.

## Key facts
- Brand: Kashvee's Bansuri Hotel / Bansuri Pure Veg Garden & Family Restaurant
- Cuisine: Indian, pure vegetarian (North Indian, South Indian, thalis; Gujarati-style snacks like masala khakhra)
- Signature dishes: Masala Khakhra, Paneer Butter Masala, dal & thali favourites
- Location: Chandekasare, Sawali Vihir Kh., Maharashtra 423601
- Corridor: Shirdi–Nashik Highway
- Coordinates: 19.8231246, 74.4509533
- Hours: Daily 8:30 AM – 11:30 PM
- Phone: +91 98901 48008
- Google rating: about 4.0 / 5 from ~345 reviews
- Local rank: #1 of ~5 places to eat in Chandekasare
- Price band: roughly ₹200–400 per person
- Amenities: garden/lawn, kids play zone, free parking, party hall, takeaway/delivery, card payments, wheelchair access

## Who it is for
- Shirdi pilgrim families needing a pure veg meal before or after darshan
- Highway travelers between Nashik and Shirdi
- Local families from Kopargaon / Chandekasare seeking garden dining with kids space
- Jain-leaning and strict vegetarian guests who want kitchen clarity (ask staff for daily preparations)

## What it is not
- Not a lodging / rooms hotel (in this region “hotel” often means restaurant)
- Not a non-veg kitchen
- Not a city fine-dining chain
